_note: [SEED] City-mode strings (M3 CITY / M8 town variety). Cities are the SOCIAL dungeon (CONTENT-IDENTITY): the identity layer is lodges/cells/front organizations. M8 adds per-town archetypes, more service verbs, per-building proprietors, and citizens so two towns and two buildings never read the same. All [SEED] until Ray's voice pass.
prompt_enter_building: [SEED] A door stands open. Step inside?
prompt_leave_city: [SEED] The gate is behind you; the map resumes, probably.

shop.name: [SEED] Sundries & Contraband
shop.greeting: [SEED] The stall opens for the right knock. Everything is for sale; some of it is yours already.

inn.name: [SEED] The Bent Nail
inn.greeting: [SEED] Rooms by the hour. Dreams are extra and not guaranteed to be your own.

rumor.name: [SEED] The Listening Post
rumor.greeting: [SEED] Someone here sells what everyone already knows, at a markup for the telling.

lodge.name: [SEED] A Door With No Sign
lodge.greeting: [SEED] You were expected. Give the word, or give a reason you don't have it.

shrine.name: [SEED] The Half-Lit Chapel-of-Ease
shrine.greeting: [SEED] A shrine to a saint whose name keeps changing. Kneel, if your certainties will let you.

bureau.name: [SEED] The Sub-Office of Minor Permanences
bureau.greeting: [SEED] Take a number. The number takes one back. A clerk will see your file, eventually, forever.

service_effects.shrine_blessed: [SEED] the changing saint marks you; the party is mended and something watches back
service_effects.shrine_refused: [SEED] you kneel and feel nothing kneel with you — no gnosis, no blessing
service_effects.bureau_filed: [SEED] your existence is stamped, cross-referenced, and filed under a name almost your own
service_effects.bureau_pending: [SEED] your file is already open; the stamp has been applied and cannot be un-applied

archetypes.port: [SEED] a salt-rotted port town; the tide leaves messages nobody admits to reading
archetypes.bureau: [SEED] a bureaucratic seat where the paperwork outnumbers the people and outranks them
archetypes.pilgrimage: [SEED] a pilgrimage stop; every third door is a shrine to a slightly different god
archetypes.market: [SEED] a market town that will sell you anything, including things you brought
archetypes.garrison: [SEED] a garrison town; the walls face inward and no one will say why

citizen_greetings: [SEED] gives you directions to a street that was demolished, warmly.
[SEED] recognizes you from a future you have not had yet.
[SEED] is counting the windows and asks you not to interrupt.
[SEED] offers to sell you your own name back at a fair price.
[SEED] warns you about the man in the grey coat, who is also them.
[SEED] says the gate moved again and points three different ways.
